review.summary: Attempt 4 is a genuine re-qualification of the readiness chunk at the new source: 105 registered commands, all exit 0, one continuous 15:25–15:57 run bound to f9cebee/6f18529, including both `--require-directional` clean packages (394 s/373 s) and `check-access-release.py --phase 28 --version 0.2.4`. The prior lows are closed in code, not prose: all seven external consumer runs now record the executed `main.rs` digest and unchanged status (replacing positional and stdout-marker identification), and delivery additionally requires an identical GitHub mirror `v0.2.4` annotated tag, with negative regressions for both. Live acceptance stays honestly unverified (1 verified, four HTTP 403). Residual issues are governance/ordering, not evidence: publication precedes any mirror verification, the new push destination and fourth delivery receipt are absent from AGENTS.md, PHASES.md and the plan, and no test binds the packaged README link to the verified remote and version.

findings.description: The packaged README's only public guide link (README.md:31, https://github.com/cdot65/scm-sdk-rs/blob/v0.2.4/docs/DIRECTIONAL_PROFILES.md) is now made resolvable by a GitHub mirror tag, but the documented order publishes first (RELEASE.md:221 `cargo publish`) and only then creates and observes the mirror tag (:229-247). Nothing before the irreversible publish establishes that the mirror repository exists or accepts the tag: docs/CI.md:7 asserts 'A public source mirror exists at GitHub' with no receipt, scripts/check-prepublication.py and scripts/check-access-release.py perform no mirror check, and tools/release_delivery.py:190-208 runs only at delivery. If the mirror push fails, delivery fails closed (correct) but the immutable crates.io archive permanently ships a dead link — the exact risk prior reviews raised.
findings.required_fix: Create and push the annotated v0.2.4 tag to both remotes and record docs/checks/release-tag-github-v0.2.4.json before `cargo publish` in docs/RELEASE.md:215-247, or add a bounded credential-free mirror reachability/tag check to scripts/check-prepublication.py so no publication occurs until the public ref is verified; then rerun the candidate guard to rebind docs/checks/phase-28-release-readiness.json.

findings.description: The new mirror requirement is enforced in code (tools/release_delivery.py:190-208 requires `delivery.github_tag_receipt`) and documented in docs/RELEASE.md:229-259 and docs/CI.md:7-9, but it is absent from the acceptance texts that govern this phase: docs/PHASES.md:299-303 still lists only registry bytes, the remote annotated tag and 49 CI contexts, and docs/typescript-035-parity-plan.md:148-157 likewise. AGENTS.md:13 names a single authorized push destination (ssh://git@git-ssh.cdot.io/...), so the newly documented `git push git@github.com:cdot65/scm-sdk-rs.git` (RELEASE.md:234) is an outward, hard-to-reverse action beyond the recorded authorization; the plan's only GitHub-mirror sentence (:188-189) concerns the upstream vendor SDK repository, not this project. No disclosure record states what mirroring full reachable history exposes (docs/reviews, contracts/sources vendor bytes, and the three unchanged tenant-identifier files counted in docs/checks/phase-28-private-material.json:13-18).
findings.required_fix: Record the mirror push authorization and the fourth delivery receipt in the governing documents (AGENTS.md push-destination clause, docs/PHASES.md phase-28 paragraph and the plan's phase-28 section), with an explicit note that the mirror publishes the full reachable history and that the identifier occurrences are unchanged public upstream source; assert the added PHASES/plan sentences in tools/test_release_024.py:77-100 as the other phase-28 documentation guards are asserted.

findings.description: No regression binds the packaged README's absolute versioned link to the remote that delivery actually verifies or to the current crate version. tools/test_release_024.py:77-84 asserts 'Crate version: **0.2.4**' and the receipt-conditional sentences, but neither the host (tools/release_delivery.py:20 GITHUB_REMOTE) nor the `v0.2.4` ref is checked, so a future version bump or a mirror-host change leaves a silently stale link inside an immutable archive while every gate still passes.
findings.required_fix: In tools/test_release_024.py, derive the expected link from release_delivery.GITHUB_REMOTE and the crates/scm-sdk/Cargo.toml version and assert README.md contains exactly that `blob/v<version>/docs/DIRECTIONAL_PROFILES.md` URL.

evidence: Evidence is executed, complete and current-source bound: docs/reviews/phase-28-chunk-release-readiness-attempt-04.checks.json:1-6 records phase 28, source_sha256 f9cebee5..., source_unchanged true, passed true; 105 `exit_code` fields are all 0, with no `"timeout": true` and no `"source_unchanged": false`. Its header is identical to docs/checks/phase-28.json:2-6 (checked_at 15:57:13.757453). executed_at runs continuously from 2026-10-22T15:25:34.690 to 15:57:13.647 with no reused checkpoint prefix (docs/CI.md forbids --resume for phase 28, asserted by tools/test_release_024.py:90).

The registered phase-28 set actually ran, including the three phase-specific commands from tools/check_phase.py:319-328: checks.json:2862-2891 and :2893-2923 are `check-management-package.py --require-directional` for 1.89.0 (393.774 s) and 1.99.0 (372.539 s), binding their receipts plus the retained .crate digests under .local/package-worktrees/6f18529a47cc273feca1000af6e4fc0d96da757e/; :2924-2955 is `check-access-release.py --phase 28 --version 0.2.4` returning version 0.2.4, releaseCommit 6f18529..., readmeSha256 ba5ae1b4..., archiveSha256 533294fe..., toolchains [1.89.0, 1.99.0]. tools/test_release_024.py:148-156 asserts this set and that the candidate guard is last.

Prior chunk finding 2 (positional consumer identity) is closed content-addressably: scripts/check-package.py:27-47 hashes the consumer main.rs before execution and re-checks it afterwards, recording consumerSourceSha256/consumerSourceUnchanged per row; scripts/check-management-package.py:165-174 now requires all seven identically invoked external runs (frozen probe, access policy, four red-team consumers, directional) to carry their expected distinct digest. docs/checks/phase-28-release-package-1.99.0.json:1009-1133 shows seven rows with seven distinct digests, frozenProbeCheckIndex 11 and directional checkIndex 17 (:767-775), sourceSha256 f9cebee... (:1140). tools/test_release_024.py:289-341 rejects wrong/absent digests, unchanged=False, an inserted identical row and swapped rows ('executed-source').

Prior chunk finding 1 (unresolvable packaged link) is now enforced rather than asserted: tools/release_delivery.py:190-208 requires, for phase 28 only, a docs/checks/release-tag-github-v0.2.4.json receipt whose remote is GITHUB_REMOTE and whose tag, sourceCommit, tagObject and both remoteRefs equal the qualified canonical tag; :256 wires it into verify(). scripts/observe-release.py:31-56 adds a bounded, credential-free `--tag-remote github` observation that still requires the annotated peeled ref to equal the qualified source. tools/test_release_024.py:28-75 proves the observer default stays ('0.2.3','canonical'), rejects an unreviewed remote before any subprocess call, rejects each tampered mirror field and a path-escaping receipt, and leaves phase 24/0.2.3 behavior unchanged. Both tests ran (checks.json:1372, 15 tests OK).

Prior chunk finding 3 (triplicated success marker) is resolved by removing the dependency: the verifier no longer matches stdout text, and crates/scm-sdk/examples/directional_profiles.rs:58's message now only appears in the recorded receipt (docs/checks/phase-28-release-package-1.99.0.json:1128), so a message change cannot fail a 390 s package run opaquely.

The directional consumer exercises the released contract from outside the crate: crates/scm-sdk/examples/directional_profiles.rs:13-32 builds ContentTypeConfiguration/ContentTypeConfigurations, enable_full_conversation_inspection(false), content_type_mode and dlp_tenant_id; :34-49 round-trips typescript:0.35.0:CreateSecurityProfileRequestSchema and asserts the hyphenated wire keys; :50-57 asserts lossless preservation of a wrong-typed value and explicit null in Mode::Response and Mode::ResponseWithoutDefaults. crates/scm-sdk/src/airs/management/profiles.rs:91,214 are the two repointed request roots. check-rust also ran the example under --no-default-features --features management on both compilers (checks.json:2821,2853).

The candidate guard is strict and version-scoped: scripts/check-access-release.py:30 registers (28,'0.2.4') and not (24,'0.2.4'); :66-71 require schema-3 proofs, wrapper.verify_receipt(require_directional=phase==28), commit_fingerprint(releaseCommit) == fingerprint(root) and HEAD ancestry; :78-113 re-read the retained archive bytes, file inventory, VCS identity, packaged-vs-filesystem-vs-release-commit byte equality for every member and all four manifests/lockfiles; :119-120 require both proofs to qualify identical files.

Security and freshness posture is current: docs/checks/phase-28-private-material.json:3-18 is a 15:25:30 scan bound to sourceSha256 f9cebee... and headCommit 6f18529 over 2439 git-visible files and 135 packaged candidates, zero credential and zero registration matches, zero new tenant occurrences; scripts/check-private-material.py:205-214 recomputes both fingerprints so the receipt cannot be stale. docs/checks/phase-28-dependencies.json:3-53 is a 15:28 audit against RustSec 640bf5a9 (commitTime 2026-10-22T12:49) with cargo-audit 0.22.2/cargo-deny 0.20.2 binary hashes, 206 dependencies, vulnerabilities found false, plus per-lockfile audits (:54+).

Live acceptance is honest and source-bound: contracts/live-evidence.json binds docs/checks/phase-28-live-attempt-01.json, whose envelope (:2-22) is read-only 1.99.0 with runtimeInputsSha256 enforced against tools/live_evidence.py:122-133 (runtime inputs exclude README/docs, so the documentation-only commit legitimately preserves the receipt), and whose report (:23-85) is crateVersion 0.2.4, mutationsEnabled false, cleanupState not_needed, one verified OAuth probe, four HTTP 403 permission prerequisites and explicit endpoint/workflow limitations.

Readiness cannot complete the phase and delivery fails closed: tools/review_phase.py:304 restricts phase-28 scopes, forbids advancing on a readiness record and invokes release_delivery.verify(phase=28, version='0.2.4'); tools/release_delivery.py:23,198-231 require release-registry-0.2.4.json, release-tag-v0.2.4.json, phase-28-remote-ci-run-N.json, require_directional proofs and retained registry bytes, and :105-116 require CI contexts to equal the configured 49-job matrix exactly. tools/test_release_024.py:158-186 proves neither path mutates docs/phase-status.json. No delivery receipt exists yet, and docs/phase-status.json:7791-7796,8351-8361 correctly keep both chunks and all milestones pending.
limitations: Read-only review: I executed nothing. I did not recompute the source fingerprint f9cebee..., the checks digest 6f2172ba..., any receipt SHA-256, or the retained .crate digests; conclusions rest on reading the recorded receipts and tracing tools/check_phase.py:319-328 against tools/review_phase.py's evidence gate.

I did not open the retained archives under .local/package-worktrees/6f18529.../.local/artifacts/ or the extracted/consumer build trees; directional and per-consumer execution is established by the recorded commands, cwds, stdout and digests plus the verifier logic in scripts/check-management-package.py:152-174.

No network calls were permitted, so I could not confirm that https://github.com/cdot65/scm-sdk-rs exists, is public, or is writable; I assessed only the repository-internal guards, documentation and ordering.

Remote delivery is the other phase-28 chunk and is unverified here: no docs/checks/release-registry-0.2.4.json, release-tag-v0.2.4.json, release-tag-github-v0.2.4.json or phase-28-remote-ci-run-N.json exists, and the 49 terminal CI contexts have not been observed on the released source. The phase-level release-readiness review (docs/reviews/phase-28-attempt-03.json, rejected at 44) must still be re-obtained and pass before publication.

Generated model correctness, the additive overlay, the oracle corpus and the schema graph are accepted phase-27 deliverables; I relied on this phase's compiler, package and fixture receipts and selected declarations rather than re-auditing crates/scm-sdk/src/models/generated.rs or src/validation/schema_graph.json.

I read no credential, tenant-registration or private-history files, nothing outside this repository, and no optional .local/typescript checkout; the verify-contracts.py --baseline .local/typescript result (extractedBaselineVerified true, checks.json:99) is taken from the recorded run.
Phase 24/25 acceptance and pre-phase-26 release infrastructure were out of scope beyond the pinned 0.2.3 receipt identity and the historical defaults asserted by tools/test_release_024.py:102-110.
